hooks.command: cd "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}" || exit 0; { echo "Session memory injected below (HANDOFF · NEXT · CHANGELOG top-2 · GOTCHAS index). These slices are COMPLETE for session start — do NOT re-read these files. Pull-on-demand map in CLAUDE.md §Session memory."; echo; [ -f living-memory/HANDOFF.md ] && { echo "## HANDOFF"; awk '/^## Handoff Template/{exit} {print}' living-memory/HANDOFF.md; echo; }; [ -f living-memory/NEXT.md ] && { echo "## NEXT"; awk '/^## Queue Hygiene Rules/{exit} {print}' living-memory/NEXT.md; echo; }; [ -f living-memory/CHANGELOG.md ] && { out=$(awk '/^## 20/{n++} n==3{exit} n>=1{print}' living-memory/CHANGELOG.md); [ -n "$out" ] && { echo "## CHANGELOG (top 2)"; echo "$out"; echo; }; }; [ -f living-memory/GOTCHAS.md ] && { out=$(awk '/<!-- GOTCHAS-INDEX:START -->/{f=1;next} /<!-- GOTCHAS-INDEX:END -->/{f=0} f' living-memory/GOTCHAS.md); [ -n "$out" ] && { echo "## GOTCHAS index"; echo "$out"; }; }; } | jq -Rs '{hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:"SessionStart",additionalContext:.}}' 2>/dev/null || true

cd "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}" || exit 0; sid=$(jq -r '.session_id // "nosession"' 2>/dev/null); marker="${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/ftf-lm-${sid}"; [ -f "$marker" ] && exit 0; lm=$(ls -t living-memory/*.md 2>/dev/null | head -1); [ -n "$lm" ] || exit 0; hit=$(find backend mobile/src web extension config -type f \( -name "*.py" -o -name "*.ts" -o -name "*.tsx" -o -name "*.js" -o -name "*.html" \) -newer "$lm" -print -quit 2>/dev/null); [ -n "$hit" ] || exit 0; touch "$marker"; jq -n --arg f "$hit" '{systemMessage:("living-memory/ is behind the code (" + $f + " is newer than every file in living-memory/). Before wrapping up: log what shipped in CHANGELOG.md and overwrite HANDOFF.md with where you stopped. See CLAUDE.md, Session memory section.")}' 2>/dev/null || true
